title: Agreeing Among Liars — The Crown of Mount Phyle
description: The Byzantine agreement results of Lamport, Shostak and Pease: four bandits on the crown, their rats and seal rings, and what each liar costs.
question: Can machines agree when some of them may lie, telling one thing to one and something else to another? How many honest machines does each liar cost?
how: We find out by exploring how four bandits holding a hilltop, some of whom might lie, agreed whether to hold it or scatter, first by plain word and then under seal.
